rawFindings.title: Incorrect URL_REGEXP removes optional http prefix with localhost
rawFindings.explanation: The URL_REGEXP regex was changed from allowing optional 'http://' and optional domain prefix (with '(?:http:\/\/[^\/]*)?\/?') to requiring 'http://' and a domain name (via 'http:\/\/[^\/]*\/'). This change breaks matching local URLs (like 'http://localhost/base/...' or 'http://127.0.0.1/base/...') that might not have trailing slashes exactly as assumed, thus breaking the source map path resolution for some stack traces.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the URL_REGEXP to the previous version that allowed optional 'http://' and optional domain and optional leading slash to correctly match all possible URLs in stack traces.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Any stack trace string with a URL starting with 'http://localhost/base/file.js:line:column' will not be matched and thus won't be rewritten to source-map original positions, causing less informative error messages.
